contentPattern.structure: two columns: one image column beside a text column (heading + paragraph + 1 CTA)

suitableFor: image-beside-text feature sections on light backgrounds
two-column layouts pairing a single cover image with a heading, paragraph and CTA
promotional split content with one image and one text/CTA column
notSuitableFor: repeating card-style item grids (use a cards variant)
reuseGuidance.notes: Created because the existing columns-minimal-light variant is text-only (noimg, contact purpose) and explicitly not suitable for image-heavy side-by-side layouts. This variant preserves the base columns image-column detection (columns-minimal-light-withimg-img-col).
